column12: + The three children put out the fire, which the king had multiplied, through their purity and confession, of fasting and prayer.

column12: The Lord saved Adam and Eve, from their captivity, He restored them to their rank once more, through prayer and fasting.

column4: + إيليا ذا الفهم الرفيع، رُفِع إلى السماء بدالة، على مركبة نارية، بالصلاة والصوم.

column12: + Elijah of the bright mind, was raised to heaven with favor, on a fiery chariot, through prayer and fasting.

column12: + Moses split the sea in two, with his rod, and deserved to speak to God, through prayer and fasting.

column12: The Lord of lords, Jesus of the great authority, fasted to teach us, the splendor of fasting, (through prayer and fasting).

column4: + وأيضاً فلنصم، بمحبة ونُسك، لكي نعبر الصعوبات، بالصلاة والصوم.

column12: + Let us also fast, with love and asceticism, that we may overcome hardships, through prayer and fasting.

column4: + فلنفهم يا أحبائي، أن رأس الحكمة، هي مخافة الله، بالصلاة والصوم.

column12: + Beloved let us understand, that the beginning of wisdom, is the fear of God, through prayer and fasting.

column12: The Ninevites and the just Lot, who lived in the early age, all received salvation, through prayer and fasting.

column12: + We receive great patience, through the love without evil, let us cling to, prayer and fasting.

column12: Be vigilant in prayers without boredom, love solitude and devotion, that you may be watchful, through prayer and fasting.

column12: We must reject, this age full of evil, to increase exceed in purity, through prayer and fasting.

column4: + لعل الله ينعم لنا، بغفران خطايانا، ويطرد عنا الشياطين، بالصلاة والصوم.

column12: + Perhaps God will grant us, forgiveness to our sins, and cast from us the demons, through prayer and fasting.

column12: + Our ascetic fathers, the teachers of the Church, fulfilled their struggle, through prayer and fasting.

column12: Let all the lovers of Christ, hold on to chastity, and purify their senses, through prayer and fasting.

column12: + For the rest of our worldly life, grant us Your help O Christ, save us from temptations, through prayer and fasting.

column4: + طوباهم الذين صاموا، ومنعوا شهواتهم، وإستمروا بلا ملل، بالصلاة والصوم.

column12: + Blessed are they that fasted, and controlled their desires, and continued without boredom, in prayer and fasting.
